events.title: Another quick patch for the demo version
events.summary: This quick patch includes the following changes in response to requests from the community (and a huge thank you for such wonderful feedback!):Added the option to limit the game’s frame rate (currently via buttons; I’ll change this to a proper slider later)Improved pathfinding and collision detection on mapsWeapons have been rebalanced. events.title: Merc Commander Demo is now available!
events.summary: A huge thank you to everyone who took part in the playtest. Thanks to your feedback, I was able to fix a huge number of small issues and polish many of the game's quality-of-life features.The work is, of course, far from finished. events.title: Merc Commander Playtest is live
events.summary: Good day, everyone.Today, I’d like to invite you to a Merc Commander playtest.For you, this could be an opportunity to get a feel for what the game is about and whether it meets your expectations. For me, it’s a chance to get some feedback.To start off, we’ll begin with 100 players (I don’t want to embarrass myself in front of a large crowd right away).Please feel free to share any thoughts you may have. Bugs, issues, ideas - please let me know about everything.
